decisions.reason: As a premium support add-on closely tied to the firm’s core digital services, it is likely to remain useful for upselling and customer retention.
The version management tool appears to fit the firm’s wider platform feature set and therefore looks strategically relevant rather than experimental.
The data processing contract tool seems more like a one-off GDPR compliance utility than a long-term core product, so it is the most likely candidate to be discontinued.
Scalable hosting for agencies was prominent at launch and aligns well with a medium-sized German information-services firm’s recurring-revenue core business.
